items.prompt: After send timeout and then a local kill-toggle,why must unresolved order exposure remain visible?
items.modelAnswer: The remote order may have been accepted/filled despite timeout. A local new-risk gate proves no cancellation. Keep reservations/unknown status,source-bound events,cancel acknowledgments and reconciliation;allow controlled cancel/reconcile work and block new uncertain risk. Need coherent durable/concurrent state,not a green local flag.

criteria.text: Separates timeout/local gate from remote outcome.
Retains unresolved exposure pending source evidence.
